en.summary: Angina is chest discomfort often triggered by exertion or stress and eased by rest. NHS: new or worsening chest pain needs urgent medical assessment — call emergency services for pain at rest, lasting >15 minutes, with breathlessness, sweating, nausea, or radiating pain (possible heart attack). Never invent GTN or other cardiac drug doses.
emergencyIf: Chest pain at rest or lasting more than 15 minutes
Pain with breathlessness, sweating, nausea, or arm/jaw radiation
doNot: Do not drive yourself with suspected heart attack

fr.summary: Angor: douleur à l'effort. Urgences si douleur au repos >15 min, dyspnée, sueurs. Pas de posologies inventées.
doNot: Pas de posologies de trinitrine inventées

he.summary: אנגינה: כאב במאמץ. חירום בכאב במנוחה >15 דק', קוצר נשימה, הזעה. אין מינונים מומצאים.

ru.summary: Стенокардия: боль при нагрузке. Неотложка при боли в покое >15 мин, одышке, поте. Дозы не выдумывать.
